offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results. Pay-as-you-go: $5 per 1,000 credits (Hobby), 2,000 credits (Standard), 2,500 credits (Growth), or 5,000 credits (Scale).
offerings.free_quota: Free Plan: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；返回 titles、descriptions 和 URLs，可选返回每个结果的 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots。
offerings.note: 搜索按每10个结果向上取整计费；搜索结果默认包含 query-relevant Highlights。

offerings.name: End-to-End ZDR
offerings.pricing: Cost: 10 credits per 10 results. ZDR search is available on Enterprise plans.
offerings.output_type: 搜索结果；端到端零数据保留。
offerings.note: Firecrawl 和上游搜索提供商均执行零数据保留。

offerings.name: Anonymized ZDR
offerings.pricing: Cost: 2 credits per 10 results. ZDR search is available on Enterprise plans.
offerings.output_type: 搜索结果；匿名化零数据保留。
offerings.note: 搜索提供商可缓存查询，但不附带识别信息。
